title: kaathale Nimmathi
desc: Kavitha is to be married to Chandramohan. However, things take a turn when her brother suspects that she is having an affair with Chandru, an archaeologist, when in fact they are strangers.

title: Sakalakala Vallavan
desc: When a poor villager's sister is sexually assaulted by the village head's son, the former vows to exact revenge and promises to get his sister married to the culprit.

title: Mr. Bharath
desc: A businessman abandons his first love, to marry a rich heiress. However, things take a turn when his illegitimate son seeks revenge for the injustice done to his mother.

title: Sathriyan
desc: When Guna, a local thug, falls in love with the daughter of a late mafia leader, he decides to turn over a new leaf. However, his girlfriend's family is against their relationship.

title: Veeram
desc: A fearless young man vows to mend his violent ways after falling in love with a beautiful maiden. However, he is forced to resort to violence after a gang of nefarious criminals pursue his lady love.
